what the app does today: The engine's Historical design started at 1960 (the archived snapshot's first year).
proposed behavior: Historical covers each place from the earliest year Crime Index publishes for it: agencies' offenses and staffing from the 1930s (Memphis from 1932), states and the nation from 1958 (checked on crimeindex.org, 2026-11-01). A year Crime Index has no figures for is said to be outside its data. Until the pre-1960 snapshot is archived, the engine answers 1960 on and says earlier years aren't loaded yet, never that they don't exist.
exact default or choices offered: From the earliest year Crime Index publishes, for agencies, states and the nation.
why: Jeff: "crime index data (staffing and offenses) should be available pre-1960 as well for agencies."
